learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn about words that have completely different or reverse meanings, known as Opposite Words or Antonyms.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Ice is very COLD 🧊, but fire is very HOT 🔥! An elephant is BIG 🐘, but an ant is SMALL 🐜. Today, let's play the game of Opposites!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Opposite words are pairs of words that mean completely different things. They are the reverse of each other. In grammar, we also call them Antonyms.

lesson_modules.module_title: 📏 Size and Weight Opposites (आकार और वजन)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Many describing words (adjectives) have opposites that tell us about size, height, and weight.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🌡️ Feeling and Action Opposites (भाव और काम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Feelings, weather, and even actions can be opposites of each other!
Words that tell us where things are going also have opposite pairs.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write the opposite of 'Tall'.
subjective_practice.hint: If someone is not tall, they are... (short)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Match the opposite: Clean -> ____
subjective_practice.hint: What happens to your clothes when you play in the mud? (dirty)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with an opposite word: The sun is hot, but the ice cream is _____.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 The Opposite Action Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Play a game with your parents. When they say 'Stand', you must 'Sit'. When they say 'Cry', you must 'Laugh'. Do the exact opposite of what they say!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Opposite words have completely different meanings.
⭐ Learning opposites helps us describe things better.
